en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a long timber-framed industrial structure with a pitched roof. The building stands on a slightly raised bank, supported by many vertical and diagonal wooden beams. At the far end is a large waterwheel beside the structure, suggesting a mill or pumping station on a watercourse. Trees and bushes partially obscure the lower part of the building; the foreground includes a sloped embankment lined with masonry blocks. The sky is blank and there is no visible printed caption or border text.
